text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I was just looking out over the camp. I've learned many things here.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I've improved so much and gained so many skills training with you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Never mind. There will come a time for this conversation, but for now…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Let's hold our heads high and advance toward the race my parents are so looking forward to—the autumn Tenno Sho.
